resources.string: Install Shizuku on the phone, or Sui on a rooted phone, to show phone apps here.
Start Shizuku on the phone, and this window opens the app.
Tap here, then allow Halone Android Integration in Shizuku\'s prompt on the phone.
Allow Halone Android Integration in the Shizuku app on the phone, then tap here.
This plugin shows the phone\'s apps on the glasses in Halone, in Android Apps. Turn it on in Halone\'s Settings → Plugins, and give it the access below.
Connected. Phone apps can open on the glasses.
Shizuku isn\'t installed. It lets this plugin show other apps on the glasses (with root, Sui works too).
Shizuku isn\'t running. Start it in the Shizuku app; it has to be started again after the phone restarts.
Shizuku is running, but this plugin isn\'t allowed to use it yet.
Access was denied. Allow Halone Android Integration in the Shizuku app.
Allowed. The dock shows when a device is connected.
Allow access to nearby devices so the dock can show when a Bluetooth device is connected.
Access to nearby devices was denied. Allow it in the app\'s settings.
This screen has an icon in the phone\'s app drawer. Hidden, it still opens from the app\'s info page in Settings.
Hidden from the app drawer. Open this screen again from Settings → Apps → Halone Android Integration.
